format:

---

```{=html}
<div class="hero-section" style="padding:2.5rem 0 1.5rem">
  <h1 style="font-size:1.9rem">Model Explorer</h1>
  <p class="lead">
    Select any service and model to explore its full evaluation profile:
    radar chart, per-category scores, individual task results, and — for
    literature synthesis tasks — a side-by-side judge comparison.
  </p>
</div>
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
lb        = FileAttachment("data/leaderboard.json").json()
per_test  = FileAttachment("data/per_test_scores.json").json()
judge_cmp = FileAttachment("data/judge_comparison.json").json()

service_colors = ({
  "grit":      "#58a6ff",
  "CIT":       "#3fb950",
  "aicommons": "#bc8cff"
})
service_labels = ({ "grit": "GRIT", "CIT": "CIT", "aicommons": "AICommons" })

cat_order = ["code_generation","metadata_generation","literature_synthesis",
             "data_interpretation","ocr","document_extraction","vision_qa"]
cat_labels_map = ({
  "code_generation":     "Code Generation",
  "metadata_generation": "Metadata Generation",
  "literature_synthesis":"Literature Synthesis",
  "data_interpretation": "Data Interpretation",
  "ocr":                 "OCR",
  "document_extraction": "Document Extraction",
  "vision_qa":           "Vision QA"
})

// Unique services present in leaderboard
services_available = [...new Set(lb.map(d => d.service))].sort()
```

---

## Select a Model

```{ojs}
viewof selected_service = Inputs.select(
  services_available,
  {
    label: "Service",
    format: v => service_labels[v] || v
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
models_for_service = lb
  .filter(d => d.service === selected_service)
  .map(d => d.model)
  .sort()
```

```{ojs}
viewof selected_model = Inputs.select(
  models_for_service,
  { label: "Model" }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Current leaderboard entry
current_lb = lb.find(d => d.service === selected_service && d.model === selected_model)

// Per-test rows for this model (canonical judge: claude preferred)
model_tests_raw = per_test.filter(d => d.service === selected_service && d.model === selected_model)

// Deduplicate: for same test_id prefer claude judge
model_tests = {
  const map = new Map();
  for (const r of model_tests_raw) {
    const k = r.test_id;
    const existing = map.get(k);
    if (!existing) { map.set(k, r); }
    else if (r.judge_model === "claude-v4.6-sonnet") { map.set(k, r); }
  }
  return [...map.values()].sort((a,b) => {
    const ci = cat_order.indexOf(a.category) - cat_order.indexOf(b.category);
    if (ci !== 0) return ci;
    return a.test_id.localeCompare(b.test_id);
  });
}

// Categories actually tested for this model
cats_tested = [...new Set(model_tests.map(d => d.category))]
```

## Model Profile


```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Radar chart data — scores per category
radar_data = cat_order.map(cat => {
  const key = "score_" + cat;
  return {
    category: cat,
    label: cat_labels_map[cat],
    score: current_lb ? (current_lb[key] ?? null) : null
  };
})
```

```{ojs}
{
  if (!current_lb)
    return htl.html``;

  // Two-column layout: radar left, bar chart right
  const svc = selected_service;
  const col = service_colors[svc];

  // ─── Radar chart ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const size   = 280;
  const cx     = size / 2;
  const cy     = size / 2;
  const r_max  = 100;
  const cats   = radar_data.filter(d => d.score !== null);
  const n      = cats.length;

  function angle(i) { return (i / n) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2; }
  function pt(score, i, scale=1) {
    const a = angle(i);
    const r = r_max * (score / 5) * scale;
    return [cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a)];
  }

  const svgR = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", size).attr("height", size)
    .style("font-family","-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif");

  // Background rings
  [1,2,3,4,5].forEach(v => {
    const pts = cats.map((_,i) => pt(v,i)).map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ");
    svgR.append("polygon").attr("points",pts)
      .attr("fill","none").attr("stroke","#30363d").attr("stroke-width",v===5?1.5:0.8);
    if (v % 2 === 0) {
      const [lx,ly] = pt(v, 0);
      svgR.append("text").attr("x",lx+3).attr("y",ly-2)
        .attr("font-size",8).attr("fill","#6e7681").text(v);
    }
  });

  // Spokes
  cats.forEach((_,i) => {
    const [x2,y2] = pt(5,i);
    svgR.append("line").attr("x1",cx).attr("y1",cy).attr("x2",x2).attr("y2",y2)
      .attr("stroke","#30363d").attr("stroke-width",0.8);
  });

  // Data polygon
  const polyPts = cats.map((d,i) => pt(d.score,i)).map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ");
  svgR.append("polygon").attr("points",polyPts)
    .attr("fill",col).attr("fill-opacity",0.15)
    .attr("stroke",col).attr("stroke-width",2);

  // Data points
  cats.forEach((d,i) => {
    const [px,py] = pt(d.score,i);
    svgR.append("circle").attr("cx",px).attr("cy",py).attr("r",4)
      .attr("fill",col).attr("stroke","#0d1117").attr("stroke-width",1.5);
  });

  // Category labels
  cats.forEach((d,i) => {
    const [lx,ly] = pt(5.6, i);
    const lines = d.label.split(" ");
    lines.forEach((line, li) => {
      svgR.append("text")
        .attr("x",lx).attr("y",ly + li*12)
        .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("dominant-baseline","middle")
        .attr("font-size",9).attr("fill","#8b949e")
        .text(line);
    });
  });

  // ─── Bar chart (right panel) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const bW   = 340;
  const bH   = size;
  const bPadL = 120, bPadR = 60, bPadT = 10, bPadB = 10;
  const barMaxW = bW - bPadL - bPadR;
  const rowH  = (bH - bPadT - bPadB) / cats.length;

  const svgB = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", bW).attr("height", bH)
    .style("font-family","-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif");

  const xS = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0,5]).range([0, barMaxW]);

  cats.forEach((d,i) => {
    const by = bPadT + i * rowH + rowH * 0.15;
    const bh = rowH * 0.7;
    const bx = bPadL;
    const scoreW = xS(d.score);

    // Background track
    svgB.append("rect").attr("x",bx).attr("y",by)
      .attr("width",barMaxW).attr("height",bh)
      .attr("rx",3).attr("fill","#1c2128");

    // Score fill
    const fillCol = d.score >= 4.5 ? "#3fb950"
                  : d.score >= 3.5 ? col
                  : d.score >= 2.5 ? "#d29922" : "#f85149";
    svgB.append("rect").attr("x",bx).attr("y",by)
      .attr("width",scoreW).attr("height",bh)
      .attr("rx",3).attr("fill",fillCol).attr("opacity",0.8);

    // Label
    svgB.append("text")
      .attr("x", bx-6).attr("y", by + bh/2 + 4)
      .attr("text-anchor","end").attr("font-size",10.5).attr("fill","#8b949e")
      .text(d.label);

    // Score text
    svgB.append("text")
      .attr("x", bx + scoreW + 5).attr("y", by + bh/2 + 4)
      .attr("font-size",10.5).attr("font-weight",700)
      .attr("fill", d.score !== null ? "#e6edf3" : "#6e7681")
      .text(d.score !== null ? d.score.toFixed(2) : "—");
  });

  // Combine into side-by-side layout
  const container = d3.create("div")
    .style("display","flex").style("align-items","center")
    .style("gap","2rem").style("flex-wrap","wrap");

  // Radar wrapper
  const radarWrap = container.append("div")
    .style("flex","0 0 auto");
  const radarTitle = radarWrap.append("div")
    .style("font-size","0.82rem").style("color","#8b949e")
    .style("margin-bottom","0.5rem").style("text-align","center")
    .text("Capability Radar");
  radarWrap.append(() => svgR.node());

  // Bar wrapper
  const barWrap = container.append("div").style("flex","1 1 300px");
  const barTitle = barWrap.append("div")
    .style("font-size","0.82rem").style("color","#8b949e")
    .style("margin-bottom","0.5rem").text("Score by Category");
  barWrap.append(() => svgB.node());

  return htl.html`
    <div class="chart-card">
      <h4>Performance Profile — ${selected_model}</h4>
      <div class="chart-subtitle">${service_labels[selected_service]} &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${current_lb?.infra}</div>
      ${container.node()}
    </div>`;
}
```

## Task-by-Task Results

```{=html}
<p class="section-subheading">
  Every individual evaluation run for this model. Scores are on a 1–5 scale.
  For literature synthesis, use the judge toggle to compare Gemini vs Claude evaluations.
</p>
```

```{ojs}
viewof judge_filter = Inputs.radio(
  ["claude-v4.6-sonnet", "gemini-3.5-flash", "all"],
  {
    label: "Judge (Lit. Synthesis)",
    value: "claude-v4.6-sonnet",
    format: v => v === "all" ? "Show both" : v
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
{
  // Filter per-test rows with judge selection
  const rows = per_test.filter(d =>
    d.service === selected_service &&
    d.model   === selected_model
  ).filter(d => {
    if (d.category !== "literature_synthesis") return true;
    if (judge_filter === "all") return true;
    return (d.judge_model || "programmatic") === judge_filter ||
           (d.judge_model || "programmatic") === "programmatic";
  }).sort((a,b) => {
    const ci = cat_order.indexOf(a.category) - cat_order.indexOf(b.category);
    if (ci !== 0) return ci;
    return a.test_id.localeCompare(b.test_id);
  });

  if (rows.length === 0)
    return htl.html`<p style="color:#8b949e;padding:1rem">No tasks found for this selection.</p>`;

  function scoreHtml(s) {
    const cls = s >= 5 ? "score-5" : s >= 4 ? "score-4" : s >= 3 ? "score-3" : s >= 2 ? "score-2" : "score-1";
    return `<span class="${cls}" style="font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700">${s}</span>`;
  }

  function judgeTag(j) {
    if (!j || j === "programmatic")
      return `<span style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#6e7681;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);padding:.1rem .4rem;border-radius:4px">programmatic</span>`;
    if (j.includes("claude"))
      return `<span style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#bc8cff;background:rgba(188,140,255,0.1);padding:.1rem .4rem;border-radius:4px">Claude</span>`;
    return `<span style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#58a6ff;background:rgba(88,166,255,0.1);padding:.1rem .4rem;border-radius:4px">Gemini</span>`;
  }

  function latencyFmt(l) {
    return l < 1 ? `${(l*1000).toFixed(0)}ms` : `${l.toFixed(1)}s`;
  }

  // Group by category
  const byCat = new Map();
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (!byCat.has(r.category)) byCat.set(r.category, []);
    byCat.get(r.category).push(r);
  }

  let html = `<div style="margin-top:0.5rem">`;

  for (const [cat, catRows] of byCat) {
    const svcCol = service_colors[selected_service];
    html += `
      <div style="margin-bottom:1.5rem">
        <div style="font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
                    letter-spacing:.08em;color:${svcCol};
                    border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;padding-bottom:.4rem;
                    margin-bottom:.5rem">
          ${cat_labels_map[cat] || cat}
        </div>`;

    catRows.forEach(r => {
      // Truncate reason to ~180 chars
      const reason = r.reason ? r.reason.substring(0,200) + (r.reason.length > 200 ? "…" : "") : "";

      html += `
        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:160px 48px 120px 90px 1fr;
                    gap:.5rem;align-items:start;
                    padding:.55rem .75rem;
                    border-radius:6px;
                    margin-bottom:3px;
                    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
                    border:1px solid #30363d;
                    font-size:0.85rem">
          <div style="color:#e6edf3;font-weight:500">${r.test_id}</div>
          <div style="text-align:center">${scoreHtml(r.score)}</div>
          <div>${judgeTag(r.judge_model)}</div>
          <div style="color:#6e7681;font-size:0.8rem">
            ${latencyFmt(r.latency_sec)} &nbsp; ${r.tps.toFixed(0)} t/s
          </div>
          <div style="color:#8b949e;font-size:0.8rem;line-height:1.4">${reason}</div>
        </div>`;
    });

    html += `</div>`;
  }

  html += `</div>`;
  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.innerHTML = html;
  return div;
}
```

## Judge Comparison — Literature Synthesis

```{=html}
<p class="section-subheading">
  For literature synthesis tasks, two LLM judges evaluated the same model outputs independently:
  <strong style="color:#58a6ff">Gemini 3.5-flash</strong> (development judge) and
  <strong style="color:#bc8cff">Claude v4.6-sonnet</strong> (production judge).
  Dots above the diagonal mean Gemini scored higher; below means Claude scored higher.
</p>
<div class="chart-card">
  <h4>Judge Agreement — Gemini vs Claude Scores</h4>
  <div class="chart-subtitle">Each dot = one literature synthesis task for the selected model. Diagonal = perfect agreement.</div>
  <div id="judge-scatter"></div>
</div>
```

```{ojs}
{
  const jRows = judge_cmp.filter(d =>
    d.service === selected_service && d.model === selected_model
  );

  if (jRows.length === 0)
    return htl.html`<p style="color:#8b949e;padding:.5rem 0">No judge comparison data for this model (may not have literature synthesis tasks or judge data).</p>`;

  const size = 280;
  const pad  = 45;
  const pW   = size - pad * 2;

  const scale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0.5,5.5]).range([0,pW]);

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", size + 80).attr("height", size)
    .style("font-family","-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif")
    .style("overflow","visible");
  const g = svg.append("g").attr("transform",`translate(${pad},${pad-10})`);

  // Diagonal
  g.append("line").attr("x1",0).attr("y1",pW).attr("x2",pW).attr("y2",0)
   .attr("stroke","#30363d").attr("stroke-dasharray","4,3").attr("stroke-width",1.5);

  // Grid
  [1,2,3,4,5].forEach(v => {
    g.append("line").attr("x1",scale(v)).attr("x2",scale(v)).attr("y1",0).attr("y2",pW)
     .attr("stroke","#30363d").attr("stroke-dasharray","2,4");
    g.append("line").attr("x1",0).attr("x2",pW).attr("y1",pW-scale(v)).attr("y2",pW-scale(v))
     .attr("stroke","#30363d").attr("stroke-dasharray","2,4");
    g.append("text").attr("x",scale(v)).attr("y",pW+14).attr("text-anchor","middle")
     .attr("font-size",9).attr("fill","#6e7681").text(v);
    g.append("text").attr("x",-8).attr("y",pW-scale(v)+3).attr("text-anchor","end")
     .attr("font-size",9).attr("fill","#6e7681").text(v);
  });

  // Axis labels
  g.append("text").attr("x",pW/2).attr("y",pW+30)
   .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",10).attr("fill","#58a6ff")
   .text("Gemini Score");
  g.append("text").attr("transform",`translate(-32,${pW/2}) rotate(-90)`)
   .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",10).attr("fill","#bc8cff")
   .text("Claude Score");

  // Tooltip
  const tip = d3.select("body").select("#jscatter-tip").node()
    ? d3.select("#jscatter-tip")
    : d3.select("body").append("div")
        .attr("id","jscatter-tip")
        .style("position","fixed").style("pointer-events","none")
        .style("background","#1c2128").style("border","1px solid #30363d")
        .style("border-radius","6px").style("padding","8px 12px")
        .style("font-size","11px").style("color","#e6edf3")
        .style("display","none").style("z-index","9999");

  // Points
  jRows.forEach(d => {
    const gScore = d.score_gemini ?? 0;
    const cScore = d.score_claude ?? 0;
    const agree  = gScore === cScore;
    const cx = scale(gScore);
    const cy = pW - scale(cScore);
    const ptCol = agree ? "#3fb950" : "#f0883e";

    g.append("circle").attr("cx",cx).attr("cy",cy).attr("r",7)
     .attr("fill",ptCol).attr("opacity",0.85)
     .attr("stroke","#0d1117").attr("stroke-width",1.5)
     .style("cursor","pointer")
     .on("mouseover", function(event) {
       d3.select(this).attr("r",9).attr("opacity",1);
       tip.style("display","block")
         .html(`<strong>${d.test_id}</strong><br>
                Gemini: ${gScore} &nbsp;·&nbsp; Claude: ${cScore}<br>
                <span style="color:${agree?"#3fb950":"#f0883e"}">${agree?"✓ Agree":"△ Differ by "+(Math.abs(gScore-cScore))}</span>`);
     })
     .on("mousemove", function(event) {
       tip.style("left",(event.clientX+14)+"px").style("top",(event.clientY-28)+"px");
     })
     .on("mouseout", function() {
       d3.select(this).attr("r",7).attr("opacity",0.85);
       tip.style("display","none");
     });
  });

  // Agreement legend
  const lx = pW + 12;
  [[  "#3fb950","Judges agree"],[  "#f0883e","Differ"]].forEach(([c,l],i) => {
    g.append("circle").attr("cx",lx+6).attr("cy",20+i*20).attr("r",6)
     .attr("fill",c).attr("opacity",0.85);
    g.append("text").attr("x",lx+16).attr("y",24+i*20)
     .attr("font-size",10).attr("fill","#8b949e").text(l);
  });

  // Agreement summary
  const nAgree = jRows.filter(d => d.score_gemini === d.score_claude).length;
  g.append("text").attr("x",pW/2).attr("y",-14)
   .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",10.5).attr("fill","#8b949e")
   .text(`${nAgree} / ${jRows.length} tasks in agreement (${Math.round(nAgree/jRows.length*100)}%)`);

  return svg.node();
}
```
